decision.reason: [ev-bceb257f17b9] says only that "there are many metric name changes." It then points to three other sections (Distributor metric changes, Embedded cache metric changes, Metrics namespace) and does not name any metric, its old or new name, or what happens to dashboards or alerts that still use the old names. The statement covers several separate changes and only refers elsewhere. To write a typed assertion we need the excerpts from those three upgrade-guide sections, or artifact diffs showing the renamed metrics.
